registrationGate.title: Create a free account to continue
registrationGate.body: Signing up lets you contact caregivers, save favorites, and send a hire request. Searching stays free and anonymous.

sections.howItWorksStep1Body: Use structured filters or plain language — whichever is easier.
sections.howItWorksStep2Body: See caregivers ranked by fit, with a clear explanation for each.
sections.howItWorksStep3Body: Create a free account to contact or hire a caregiver.
sections.verifiedBody: Caregivers with a verified qualification have had their credentials checked against the issuing institution. We show this clearly so you can weigh it in your decision.
sections.safetyBody: We never show a caregiver's contact details, address, or identification documents publicly. Sensitive health information is kept separate and is never part of public search.
sections.multilingualBody: This site works in English, Sinhala, and Tamil.
sections.ctaTitle: Ready to find the right caregiver?
sections.ctaBody: Start with a search above — no account needed.

footer.disclaimer: Search results are ranked automatically based on the filters you provide. They are not a recommendation or guarantee of fit.

register.heroTitle: Find and hire the right caregiver for your family
register.heroSubtitle: Create a free account to contact caregivers directly, save your favorites, and send hire requests.
register.benefit1Body: Reach out to any caregiver in your search results once you're signed up.
register.benefit2Body: Keep a shortlist of caregivers you're considering and come back to them anytime.
register.benefit3Body: Start the hiring conversation directly through CareLink Finder.
register.formSubtitle: It only takes a minute — searching stays free either way.
register.consentLabel: I agree to the data processing consent and terms of use.
register.successBody: We've sent a verification link to your email address. Verify it to activate your account and sign in.

login.title: Sign in to your account
